Tenant.description: A resident of one of the buildings. A first name alone is not an identity.

Building.description: A block of flats the union covers.

Post.description:
A union office held for one building: its rep or its secretary.
Holding one office does not mean holding the other.

Household.description: How two tenants share a home: flatmates, or one lets a room to the other.

Complaint.description: A problem reported about a building. status says open, escalated or resolved; inspected stays empty until an inspection is recorded.

messages.text:
Lindiwe Hartmann: The lift in Ashgrove House has been out for 9 days. I raised it with Callum Fairbairn on Monday.
Callum Fairbairn: I logged your complaint, Lindiwe, and I will chase the agent myself.

facts.in: The lift in Ashgrove House has been out for 9 days.

messages.text:
Hi Naledi,

Bartosz Osei and Lindiwe Osei both signed the petition, but Lindiwe Hartmann did not. Osei will bring the forms on Thursday, and Lindiwe is collecting the rest.

Best,
Dmitar Kolev

Residents' meeting, Tallow Court.
Chair Ottoline Brask: "We vote on the bike store first." Yoshiro Hartmann objected, "it eats the courtyard," and someone at the back shouted "call the question". Ottoline gave her answer as "the vote stands". My own margin note read "bike store: revisit".
quotes: We vote on the bike store first.

messages.text:
Naledi Sithole: My flat is the one over the bins, number 4.
Bartosz Osei: Mine is above yours, and my flatmate Callum Fairbairn says the smell reaches him too.
Naledi Sithole: Then tell him I will bring it to the committee.
Callum Fairbairn is Ottoline Brask's flatmate, but she says her lodger Dmitar Kolev pays the rent and keeps his own key.

facts.in: Callum Fairbairn is Ottoline Brask's flatmate
facts.label: flatmate

messages.text:
Forwarded note:

Dmitar Kolev and Dmitar Raskin share one letterbox at Brindle Yard. Raskin collects on Mondays; Dmitar leaves the rest for Lindiwe Verhoeven, who has kept it tidy since March.

Sent by the clerk
Ottoline Brask: Can Yoshiro Hartmann witness the damp complaint for Tallow Court on Friday? Hartmann has the photos, and Lindiwe Hartmann says Yoshiro already promised to bring them.

facts.in: Can Yoshiro Hartmann witness the damp complaint for Tallow Court on Friday?

messages.text: Naledi Sithole told the meeting that Dmitar Raskin had escalated the boiler complaint for Ashgrove House, and that he had counted 14 flats without heating. Callum denied it.

facts.in: Dmitar Raskin had escalated the boiler complaint for Ashgrove House

messages.text: Attendees: Lindiwe Hartmann, Lindiwe Osei, Bartosz Osei, Yoshiro Hartmann and Ottoline Brask. Apologies: Lindiwe Verhoeven. Osei proposed the new rota, Hartmann seconded, Bartosz asked about the budget, and Lindiwe asked whether the minutes could go out sooner.

Lindiwe Osei emailed: "The bin store is flooded again." Bartosz Osei, her brother-in-law, answered "I saw it on Sunday" and Naledi Sithole added "it needs a pump, not a mop." One neighbour only wrote "same here".
quotes: The bin store is flooded again.
it needs a pump, not a mop.

messages.text:
Dmitar Raskin: I did not raise the roof leak, the caretaker did. He told me they would send someone.
Lindiwe Verhoeven: They told me the same. Who is their contact?
Dmitar Raskin: I only have a mobile number, ask Naledi, she rang them.

facts.in: I did not raise the roof leak

messages.text: If Brindle Yard agrees, Ottoline Brask will escalate the stairwell light complaint, and I think Callum Fairbairn can witness it, though he has not said yes.

facts.in: Ottoline Brask will escalate the stairwell light complaint

messages.text: Lindiwe Hartmann and Naledi Sithole told Callum Fairbairn that they could not attend, so he asked their neighbours to cover for them.

Subject: Re: Ashgrove House lift

Ashgrove House lift is fixed, 31 flats are back in service, and the engineer's inspection was done on Wednesday. Thanks for the push, Lindiwe.

Callum

facts.in: Ashgrove House lift is fixed, 31 flats are back in service, and the engineer's inspection was done on Wednesday

messages.text:
Yoshiro Hartmann: Ottoline told me "the landlord won't meet before May", and honestly I don't believe her.
Ottoline Brask: I said "unless we go in as a group", you cut me off.
quotes: the landlord won't meet before May
unless we go in as a group

messages.text: Meeting log. Bartosz Osei: "I will chase the agent about the roof," he promised. Dmitar Kolev replied, "you said that last autumn," and Dmitar Raskin laughed that "somebody should write it down". Kolev wrote it down. Raskin then asked Osei for the agent's number.
quotes: I will chase the agent about the roof,

messages.text: Tallow Court has a damp problem and Brindle Yard has a rat problem. It is the older block, so Naledi Sithole thinks it will get repaired first, but she also says it is the worse of the two.

facts.in: Tallow Court has a damp problem
Brindle Yard has a rat problem

messages.text: Lindiwe Hartmann and Lindiwe Osei met the surveyor, and Lindiwe from number 9, who is neither of them, took the notes.
Naledi Sithole forwarded this from the agent: "Dmitar Kolev has paid, but Dmitar Raskin has not, and he knows why." She added "please do not reply all".
quotes: Dmitar Kolev has paid, but Dmitar Raskin has not, and he knows why.

messages.text: Per Lindiwe Osei: "my building rep never answers". Per Lindiwe Hartmann: "I am the rep, ask me." Neither is said to have sent the other a message.
quotes: I am the rep, ask me.

messages.text: Naledi Sithole is the rep for Ashgrove House, and Callum Fairbairn is its secretary. Yoshiro Hartmann is not its secretary.

facts.in: Naledi Sithole is the rep for Ashgrove House
facts.label: rep

facts.in: Yoshiro Hartmann is not its secretary
facts.label: secretary

messages.text: Tallow Court's minute taker is Bartosz Osei, and Brindle Yard says Ottoline Brask will represent it until Lindiwe Osei is back.

facts.in: Tallow Court's minute taker is Bartosz Osei
facts.label: secretary

questions.q: Who is the rep of Ashgrove House?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Building)-[:rep]->(n1:Tenant) WHERE n0.name = 'Ashgrove House' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.speaker: nal
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Tenant)-[:represents]->(n1:Building) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name
MATCH (n0:Tenant)-[:flatmate]->(n1:Tenant) WHERE n0.name = 'Ottoline Brask' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Who is the sublessor of Dmitar Kolev?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Tenant)-[:sublessor]->(n1:Tenant) WHERE n0.name = 'Dmitar Kolev' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Is there a record of an inspection for Ashgrove House?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Building)<-[:building]-(n1:Complaint) WHERE n0.name = 'Ashgrove House' RETURN coalesce(n1.inspected, false) AS inspected

questions.q: How many flats does the boiler complaint affect?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Complaint) WHERE n0.detail = 'boiler' RETURN n0.units_affected AS units_affected

questions.q: Which complaints did Dmitar Raskin raise?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Tenant)<-[:raised_by]-(n1:Complaint) WHERE n0.name = 'Dmitar Raskin' RETURN n1.detail AS detail

questions.speaker: yosh
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Tenant)<-[:witness]-(n1:Complaint) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.detail AS detail

questions.q: What status is the damp complaint in?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Complaint) WHERE n0.detail = 'damp' RETURN n0.status AS status
MATCH (n0:Complaint)-[:witness]->(n1:Tenant) WHERE n0.detail = 'damp' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Who is the secretary of Tallow Court?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Building)-[:secretary]->(n1:Tenant) WHERE n0.name = 'Tallow Court' RETURN n1.name AS name
MATCH (n0:Tenant) WHERE n0.name = 'Naledi Sithole' RETURN n0.email AS email

questions.speaker: ott
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Tenant)-[:subtenant]->(n1:Tenant) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Who raised the complaints about Tallow Court?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Building)<-[:building]-(n1:Complaint)-[:raised_by]->(n2:Tenant) WHERE n0.name = 'Tallow Court' RETURN n2.name AS name
